        rw [h₈]
        have h₉ : a ^ y ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [h₉, sub_ne_zero.mpr h₆]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [h₉, sub_ne_zero.mpr h₆]
        <;> ring_nf
      have h₈ : (a : ℝ) ^ (-y) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
        have h₉ : (a : ℝ) ^ y > 0 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h₁ y
        have h₁₀ : (a : ℝ) ^ (-y) - 1 = -(a ^ y - 1) / a ^ y := h₇
        rw [h₁₀]
        have h₁₁ : a ^ y - 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply h₆; linarith
        have h₁₂ : a ^ y > 0 := by positivity
        field_simp [h₁₁, h₁₂.ne']
        <;>
        (try norm_num) <;>
        (try linarith) <;>
        (try nlinarith) <;>
        (try ring_nf) <;>
        (try field_simp [h₁₁, h₁₂.ne']) <;>
        (try linarith)
      have h₉ : (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) (-y) = (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) y := by
        have h₁₀ : (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) (-y) = F (-y) * (1 / ((a : ℝ) ^ (-y) - 1) + 1 / 2) := rfl
        have h₁₁ : (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) y = F y * (1 / ((a : ℝ) ^ y - 1) + 1 / 2) := rfl
        rw [h₁₀, h₁₁]
        have h₁₂ : F (-y) = -F y := h₄ y
        rw [h₁₂]
        have h₁₃ : 1 / ((a : ℝ) ^ (-y) - 1) = -a ^ y / (a ^ y - 1) := by
          have h₁₄ : (a : ℝ) ^ (-y) - 1 = -(a ^ y - 1) / a ^ y := h₇
          rw [h₁₄]
          have h₁₅ : a ^ y > 0 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h₁ y
          have h₁₆ : a ^ y - 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply h₆; linarith
          field_simp [h₁₆, h₁₅.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₁₆, h₁₅.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
        rw [h₁₃]
        have h₁₄ : -F y * (-a ^ y / (a ^ y - 1) + 1 / 2) = F y * ((a ^ y + 1) / (2 * (a ^ y - 1))) := by
          have h₁₅ : a ^ y > 0 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h₁ y
          have h₁₆ : a ^ y - 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply h₆; linarith
          field_simp [h₁₆, h₁₅.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₁₆, h₁₅.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
        have h₁₅ : F y * (1 / ((a : ℝ) ^ y - 1) + 1 / 2) = F y * ((a ^ y + 1) / (2 * (a ^ y - 1))) := by
          have h₁₆ : a ^ y > 0 := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h₁ y
          have h₁₇ : a ^ y - 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply h₆; linarith
          field_simp [h₁₇, h₁₆.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₁₇, h₁₆.ne']
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> linarith
        rw [h₁₄, h₁₅]
        <;>
        (try ring_nf) <;>
        (try field_simp [h₆]) <;>
        (try linarith)
      exact h₉
  -- Use the main result to conclude the proof
  have h₁ : ∀ (y : ℝ), (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) (-y) = (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) y := h_main
  have h₂ : Even (λ x => F x * (1 / (a ^ x - 1) + 1 / 2)) := by
    rw [even_iff_forall]
    intro y
    exact h₁ y
  exact h₂
